title: Potential targets of baicalein in macrophages revealed by bulk and single cell RNA sequencing analysis.
authors: Li, Ping; Hu, Jianran; Zhang, Yan; Bai, Xia
one_liner_zh: 该文通过RNA测序和分子对接研究黄酮类化合物baicalein在巨噬细胞中的抗炎靶点，虽涉及分子对接但核心是药物靶点与炎症通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Excessive inflammation drives organ dysfunction and high mortality in life-threatening conditions such as sepsis. Baicalein, a bioactive flavonoid, possesses well-recognized anti-inflammatory properties, yet its molecular targets in macrophages and potential systemic immunomodulatory effects on peripheral blood immune cells under hyperinflammatory conditions remain poorly characterized. Our previous studies demonstrated that baicalein alleviates hepatic inflammation in mice with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and inhibits NF-kappaB nuclear translocation in RAW264.7 macrophages. Here, by integrating network pharmacology, molecular docking, bulk RNA sequencing of macrophages, and single-cell RNA sequencing of peripheral blood from sepsis patients, we identified JAK2, SRC, TP53, MAPK3, AKT1, HSP90AA1, and ESR1 as potential core targets of baicalein in macrophages, and validated that the JAK2-STAT3 and NF-kappaB pathways might be the key downstream regulatory axes of its anti-inflammatory effects. Furthermore, we revealed that baicalein may modulate, based on single-cell expression signatures, the inflammatory phenotype of multiple peripheral blood immune cell populations, including monocytes, T cells, B cells, and granulocyte-monocyte progenitors, suggesting a potential systemic anti-inflammatory effect that requires experimental validation in human cells. Collectively, our findings elucidate the potential molecular targets of baicalein in macrophages and its multi-cellular immunoregulatory mechanisms under hyperinflammation, providing novel mechanistic insights for the clinical application of baicalein in inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 过度炎症在脓毒症等危及生命的疾病中驱动器官功能障碍和高死亡率。黄芩素（Baicalein）作为一种具有生物活性的类黄酮，拥有公认的抗炎特性，但其在巨噬细胞中的分子靶点以及在超炎症条件下对外周血免疫细胞的潜在系统性免疫调节作用仍鲜有表征。我们此前的研究表明，黄芩素可缓解非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）小鼠的肝脏炎症，并抑制RAW264.7巨噬细胞中NF-kappaB的核转位。在此，通过整合网络药理学、分子对接、巨噬细胞批量RNA测序以及脓毒症患者外周血单细胞RNA测序，我们鉴定了JAK2、SRC、TP53、MAPK3、AKT1、HSP90AA1和ESR1作为黄芩素在巨噬细胞中的潜在核心靶点，并验证了JAK2-STAT3和NF-kappaB通路可能是其抗炎作用的关键下游调控轴。此外，基于单细胞表达特征，我们揭示黄芩素可能调节多种外周血免疫细胞群体（包括单核细胞、T细胞、B细胞和粒细胞-单核细胞祖细胞）的炎症表型，提示其具有潜在的系统性抗炎效应，这需要在人类细胞中进行实验验证。总体而言，我们的发现阐明了黄芩素在巨噬细胞中的潜在分子靶点及其在超炎症条件下的多细胞免疫调节机制，为黄芩素在炎症性疾病中的临床应用提供了新的机制性见解。
